package: @astryxdesign/core

## Parameters

| Param | Type | Default | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `ref` | `RefObject<HTMLElement \| null>` | - | The ref of the one element to animate, the same ref you pass to the element: another hook, such as a gesture hook, can take it too, so a drag and an animation share one element. After every render the animator follows the element behind it. When the element unmounts its motion stops and its values return to rest, so a remount starts at rest, and so does a node that replaces it. Before the element mounts, and while it is unmounted, every call does nothing and `animate` and `decay` resolve at once. **(required)** |
